name: argus-probe-webui
description: Probes for the argus Web UI. `probes` runs the self-contained ones in CI; `ws` and `ui` need a running argus server on http://localhost:8787/ and stay manual; `docs-shots` regenerates docs/ui/*.png and is manual because it writes files instead of asserting anything.

scripts.probes: npm run probe:version && npm run probe:related-logs && npm run probe:follow-tail && npm run probe:json-expand && npm run probe:splitter
